adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (semantic Gaussian occupancy and free-space evidence) changes through fixed-rule correction of stored state, migration between memory tiers, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
